listings.description: Bright end-unit townhouse on a quiet lane in Maple Harbor. An open living area flows to an updated kitchen with quartz counters and a breakfast bar. Enjoy a private patio and a small fenced yard, plus a garage with storage.

Contemporary condo in Silver Quay with wide canal views from the main living area. Floor-to-ceiling windows, a sleek kitchen, and a primary suite with a walk-in closet create an easy, refined vibe. Building amenities include a fitness room, pool, and secure parking.

Modern single-family home in Aurora Bend featuring a grand two-story foyer and a chef's kitchen. The layout includes a main-level suite, a generous bonus room, and custom built-ins. A three-car garage and a landscaped backyard with a fire pit make entertaining effortless.

Charming cottage in Cedar Meadow with original hardwoods and a sunny front porch. The remodeled kitchen opens to a dining nook overlooking the garden. Newer roof and energy-efficient windows add comfort and peace of mind.

Industrial-style loft in Lantern Hollow with 12-foot ceilings and exposed beams. Massive windows drench the space in light and frame cityscape sunsets. A large island kitchen and a walk-in closet provide practical everyday comfort.

Well-maintained duplex in Stonebridge Commons with two distinct residences under one roof. Each side has a bright living area and an updated kitchen, ideal for multi-generational living or rental income. Separate entrances, modernized systems, and off-street parking complete the package.

Smartly designed studio in Pinebrook Flats that maximizes every square foot. A flexible living zone includes an alcove for a murphy bed and a full-size closet. Private balcony and access to a shared laundry room make daily routines easy.

Skyline-view penthouse in Crown Vista with a private elevator entrance. An expansive great room opens to a wraparound terrace for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Spa-like baths and two dedicated parking spaces elevate the experience.

Comfortable ranch in Willow Trace with single-level living and an airy great room. The updated kitchen features stainless appliances and a walk-in pantry. A covered patio overlooks a fenced yard with raised garden beds and a storage shed.

Contemporary rowhouse in Riverlight Green with a sunny open-plan main level. The top floor includes a flexible loft for office or media space and opens to a rooftop deck with planter boxes. An attached garage with an EV outlet and ample storage adds everyday convenience.
